general.launchAtLoginHint: Start File Chameleon in the background when you sign in.
general.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
general.closeToTrayHint: Off: closing the window quits the app.
general.contextMenuHint: Adds an entry that opens the wheel when you right-click files.
general.downloadQualityHint: Not used for audio and GIF downloads.
general.cookiesHint: Lets downloads use your signed-in session for sites that need it. Cookies are only read by the downloader on this device and never leave it.

appearance.uiScaleHint: Makes everything in the main window larger or smaller.
appearance.reduceMotionHint: Turns animations off so changes happen instantly.
appearance.wheelShowDetailHint: Slices show details such as quality, ratio or size.

shortcuts.enableHint: Hold Ctrl while dragging a file to open a wheel of formats.
shortcuts.anyAppHint: Off: only in File Explorer and the desktop.
shortcuts.flipScrollHint: While the wheel is open, scrolling switches between the front and back face.
shortcuts.shiftBackHint: Holding Shift together with Ctrl while dragging opens the wheel on its back face.
shortcuts.excluded: Apps where the wheel never opens
shortcuts.excludedHint: In these apps, Ctrl+drag works as usual.
shortcuts.howBody: Start dragging a file, press and hold Ctrl, then drop it on a format.

hotkeys.title: Global shortcuts
hotkeys.hint: These work in every app. Click a box and press the keys; Esc cancels, Backspace turns the shortcut off.
hotkeys.shelfHint: Your recent copies open at the top of the screen.
hotkeys.libraryHint: Opens the Clipboard page in this window.
hotkeys.downloadLinkHint: Opens the media link on the clipboard in the Download page.
hotkeys.lineHint: Opens the clipboard line at the top of the screen and gives it focus.
hotkeys.conflict: Another app already uses this shortcut, or Windows reserves it. Choose a different one.
hotkeys.lineSearchHint: Opens the line with the search field focused.
hotkeys.captureHint: Hangs the screen under the cursor on the line as an image. Suggestion: Ctrl+Alt+A
hotkeys.copyLatestImageHint: Copies the newest image on the line to the clipboard.

clipboard.enableHint: Saves what you copy so you can find it later.
clipboard.pauseHint: The history stays, but new copies are not recorded. Also available from the tray.
clipboard.suggestHint: A short suggestion appears in the corner of the screen.
clipboard.retentionHint: Pinned items, items in a folder, tagged items and items with a title or note are never deleted.
clipboard.maxItemsHint: Past the limit, the oldest unsaved items are removed.
clipboard.ignoreAppsHint: Copies made in these apps never reach the clipboard history.
clipboard.ocrHint: Windows' built-in text recognition runs on this device; the text becomes searchable and copyable.
clipboard.linkTitlesHint: The page title of a copied link is downloaded once in the background, so the site receives a request. Local addresses and links that look like they carry secrets are skipped.
clipboard.foldersHint: New images added to these folders (screenshots, for example) are added to the clipboard. Up to 3 folders.
clipboard.foldersFull: Up to 3 folders can be watched.
clipboard.shelfHint: The quick paste panel that opens at the top of the screen with a hotkey.
clipboard.clearUnsavedHint: Items that are not pinned, filed, tagged, titled or noted move to the trash.
clipboard.clearMessage: They move to the trash; you can restore them for 30 days.
clipboard.emptyTrashHint: Items in the trash are deleted for good.

engines.note: FFmpeg found on your PATH is used automatically. Download it here only if you do not have it.
engines.updated: {name} was updated to the latest version

purpose.deno: Script runtime some sites need for downloads

about.licensesValue: File Chameleon is open source. Optional engines keep their own licenses (FFmpeg: GPL-3.0, yt-dlp: Unlicense, PDFium: BSD-3-Clause, Deno: MIT).
about.credits: Inspired by Filee, Nashi and Clipboardline; not affiliated with them.
